seo.title: Aarsh Chaurasia | AI Security Engineer & Researcher
seo.description: Aarsh Chaurasia, Security Engineer and AI Security Researcher. Founding Security Engineer Intern at Vaatun, previously Security Assurance Intern at Microsoft (Azure DevSec) and Product Security at we45. Founder of Okynus Tech, incubated at C3iHub, IIT Kanpur.

hero.name: Aarsh Chaurasia
hero.eyebrow: Security Engineer · AI Security Researcher · Founder
hero.subtitle:
I build things and think about what could go wrong. AI interests me both for the problems it helps solve and the new ones it creates.

My work spans security engineering at Microsoft, product security at we45 and building Okynus Tech from scratch.

I’m a generalist by approach. I like trying unfamiliar things, asking questions and working through problems without an obvious answer.

about.heading: Practitioner. Researcher. Founder.
bio: I work where AI meets real attack surface: finding how intelligent systems fail, and building what keeps them safe.
Today that’s at Vaatun. Before it came Microsoft and we45, and Okynus Tech, a security company I founded out of IIT Kanpur’s C3iHub and took to a ~$500K valuation.
about.quote: That sounds interesting, let’s try it.

experience.description:
Building sovereign AI infrastructure and agentic security tooling for production AI workloads.

Key contributions

• Architected sovereign AI inference across multi cloud infrastructure, migrating workloads from third party model APIs to controlled infrastructure to strengthen data security and privacy

• Built agentic AI security scanners and automated security pipelines, strengthening security controls across production AI workflows and reducing security and operational risk

• Optimized cloud infrastructure and agentic AI workflows, improving uptime while reducing costs by ~30%

Built AI driven security testing infrastructure for internal Microsoft MCP servers with the Azure DevSec Team.

Key contributions

• Built an AI driven security testing platform for internal Microsoft MCP servers using advanced static analysis and agentic AI dynamic analysis to identify security weaknesses at scale for the Azure DevSec Team

• The platform identified and validated vulnerabilities across internal MCP ecosystems including authorization flaws, unsafe tool exposure and capability escalation paths through automated hybrid security analysis

• Developed distributed orchestration pipelines to simulate multi step agent interactions and runtime execution flows for large scale security testing of enterprise AI infrastructure

Product security and DevSecOps for enterprise SaaS platforms.

Key contributions

• Designed and implemented DevSecOps CI/CD security pipelines for large scale enterprise SaaS platforms using GitHub Actions with SAST, DAST, dependency and secret scanning

• Triaged and analyzed 300+ security alerts, vulnerability findings and scan results across CI/CD pipelines and production systems achieving time to triage under 24 hours and prioritizing exploitable vulnerabilities

• Performed web and API security testing for an enterprise communications platform aligned with the OWASP Top 10, identifying authorization, access control, data exposure and business logic flaws

• Served as a bug bounty triager for an enterprise software vendor, validating submissions through manual security analysis and controlled testing, reviewing 100+ reports and contributing to signal validation and monitoring workflows

Founded and led an enterprise security venture incubated under IIT Kanpur's C3iHub.

What I did

• Architected a patent grade encryption algorithm and data protection mechanisms for OkSentinel, a proprietary secure data sharing platform leveraging novel algorithms to protect sensitive enterprise data

• Built an agentic AI retesting system for OkNexus to automatically revalidate security findings within CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual triage effort by ~70% and accelerating verification turnaround

• Led technical validation and security architecture across application security, cloud security and threat modelling, taking Okynus from product validation to a ~$500K valuation through IIT Kanpur C3iHub and SSIP 2.0

Worked on penetration testing and security auditing for application platforms and internal security tooling.

What I did

• Performed penetration testing on web applications identifying vulnerabilities in authentication flows access control mechanisms and application logic

• Conducted security assessments focusing on attack surface analysis misconfigurations and security weaknesses across application environments

• Contributed to testing and evaluation of an AI driven firewall auditing platform designed to analyze security configurations and highlight potential defensive gaps

Worked on backend systems and internal developer tools focused on data infrastructure API development and secure data handling.

What I did

• Built a File Array Manager tool enabling secure upload preview and management of multiple file types through a token based API

• Improved the XDSArray backend system to enhance scalability reliability and data handling performance

• Developed the XDSArray API providing a modular interface for secure high performance data storage and retrieval with token based access control

• Built a JPDB API Explorer tool for testing and debugging live API requests improving backend development workflows and secure API validation

Worked on analyzing large scale government datasets to identify security anomalies and potential fraudulent activities.

What I did

• Analyzed large datasets to detect anomalies patterns and suspicious activity indicating potential fraud or misuse

• Investigated irregular data patterns and helped identify cases of fraudulent activity within government program datasets

• Supported data security efforts by improving monitoring approaches for identifying abnormal behavior across data systems

Conducted research on challenges posed by modern encryption in mobile operating systems and their impact on digital forensic investigations.

What I did

• Co authored research on improving mobile device forensics using dynamic analysis AI assisted pattern detection and cloud based forensic techniques

• Designed simulations to analyze encrypted systems and observe transient decrypted states during runtime

• Used tools such as Frida and Xposed Framework to monitor application behavior and identify potential weaknesses in encrypted environments

• Explored scalable forensic approaches using cloud based analysis for distributed data and key management systems

Built and led a technology driven startup focused on improving digital visibility and performance for online platforms.

What I did

• Played a key role in scaling the startup and improving client outcomes contributing to the company’s eventual acquisition

• Led development and execution of SEO strategies that improved online visibility traffic growth and overall platform performance for clients

• Designed a custom SEO optimization engine to automate analysis and optimization of website structures and search performance

• Used data driven insights to continuously refine campaigns improve search rankings and support client growth objectives

• Worked closely with product and engineering teams to integrate optimization tools and maintain efficient scalable workflows

Led the university chapter of Google Developer Student Clubs fostering a community focused on learning building and collaboration in modern technologies.

What I did

• Successfully completed multiple GDSC campaigns driving strong student participation and engagement across the university

• Organized and hosted technical workshops and events on Android development cloud computing and AI ML with large student attendance

• Led hands on sessions hackathons and coding challenges helping students build practical technical skills

• Collaborated with industry professionals and guest speakers to deliver technical sessions and mentorship opportunities

• Managed and coordinated a team to plan events run community initiatives and expand overall club participation

projects.name: EngineerSec
projects.desc: AI native platform that automates threat modeling, vulnerability discovery, remediation and CI/CD security. It turns architecture and code context into prioritized, exploitable findings and drives fixes straight through the pipeline.

projects.name: Intelligent Storage Evidence Analyzer
projects.desc: Agentic AI powered forensic system that detects intentional disk wiping and identifies the tools used in data destruction. It analyzes disk images using entropy detection tool fingerprinting and behavioral intent modeling to support digital forensic investigations.

projects.name: PayloadScope
projects.desc: Machine learning system that classifies malicious web exploitation payloads such as XSS SQL Injection SSTI and Command Injection using TF IDF character n gram vectorization with a Logistic Regression multi class classifier. The system normalizes encoded inputs before analysis and supports both a REST API for automated pipelines and a GUI for manual payload inspection.

projects.name: PhishSOC-AI
projects.desc: PhishSOC-AI is an advanced, AI driven phishing detection platform designed for Security Operations Centers (SOC). It automates phishing email analysis through multi layered inspection, combining NLP-based sentiment classification, threat intelligence enrichment, screenshot forensics, and real-time Splunk integration

projects.name: SecuriForge
projects.desc: SecuriForge is a unified binary security and risk analysis framework that combines hardening checks, reverse engineering risk assessment, malware tampering detection, and SBOM generation into a single tool.

research.title: Navigating the Frontiers of Encryption in Mobile Forensics
research.subtitle: Mobile forensics with hybrid AI and cloud computing
research.desc: This paper explores advanced approaches to overcoming encryption challenges in mobile device forensics by leveraging AI algorithms alongside cloud computing resources.

research.title: Towards Behavioural Secure Authentication Using Keystroke Dynamics
research.subtitle: Biometric authentication with ensemble machine learning classifiers
research.desc: Presents a keystroke dynamics-based authentication framework using ensemble classifiers (SVM, KNN, Random Forest), emphasizing accuracy improvements and dynamic thresholding to reduce false rejections.

research.title: Complex Resource Allocation and Energy Consumption in 5G and Modern Wireless Networks
research.subtitle: Analyzing energy efficiency challenges in advanced wireless technologies
research.desc: Investigates the complexities of resource allocation in 5G and beyond networks, highlighting causes of higher energy consumption and proposing potential optimization strategies.

blogs.title: Building PhishSOC and Winning at HackIITK 2025 Experience
blogs.desc:
Built PhishSOC, an AI driven phishing detection platform for Security Operations Centers during HackIITK 2025 at IIT Kanpur. The system combined NLP based email analysis screenshot forensics and threat intelligence to detect sophisticated phishing attempts.

Competed against more than 4000 teams nationwide and secured 2nd Runner Up (3rd place) in the national finale.

blogs.title: The Automation Paradox: How Security Tools Create New Vulnerabilities
blogs.desc: Explores how modern security automation tools like CI CD scanners vulnerability managers and security platforms can themselves become attack vectors. The article analyzes incidents such as SolarWinds CodeCov and CircleCI to show how compromised security tooling can expose thousands of organizations at once and outlines strategies to secure security automation infrastructure.

blogs.title: Shift Left Is Dead — Shift Smart: What Enterprises Should Actually Do
blogs.desc: Explores why traditional “shift left” security often fails in practice due to tool overload alert fatigue and lack of developer security expertise. The article proposes Shift Smart, a risk based approach that prioritizes high risk systems combines automation with human judgment and emphasizes threat modeling and security architecture over excessive scanning.

blogs.title: Will Your Encryption Survive the Quantum Leap?
blogs.desc: Explains how advances in quantum computing are accelerating the need for post-quantum cryptography and why organizations must begin planning now. The article outlines the complexity of enterprise cryptographic migration and strategies for building crypto-agile systems ready for NIST’s new post-quantum standards.
